I reviewed this directly instead of launching sub-agents. The change is four new files and 126 lines. There is no CLAUDE.md in the repo, so I checked bugs only. I did not run the app; each finding comes from reading the diff.

app.js:46 Out-of-order search responses are appended to the list, and every keystroke sends the query. Each input event synchronously re-renders local results, then fires an unthrottled fetch; each response appends to whatever is on screen. No AbortController, no sequence check, no res.ok check (a 404 HTML page throws in res.json and is only console.log'd). openNote or removeNote also call renderList, which wipes shared rows silently. Traced. Type 'ab' quickly. Request for 'a' and request for 'ab' are in flight; the render for 'ab' has already cleared the list. Responses arrive in either order and both sets of shared rows are appended, so stale results for 'a' appear under 'ab', often twice. Every keystroke also sends the partial search text to the server with no consent step.

app.js:11 Note titles and shared-note titles are written into innerHTML unescaped (stored XSS). app.js:10-11 interpolates n.title into a template assigned via innerHTML; app.js:46 does the same with s.title from /api/shared. Driven: a stored note titled set window.x on page load; a shared result with the same title also executed. A note titled runs script on every render. The same payload from /api/shared (other users' notes) runs in every searcher's page.

app.js:46 Clicking a shared-note row throws and leaves currentNote undefined. Shared li elements carry no data-id. The list click handler (app.js:30-33) matches any li, so Number(undefined) = NaN is passed to openNote. notes.find returns undefined, then app.js:18 reads currentNote.title and throws. Search for anything that returns a shared note, click it: TypeError in the console, nothing opens, currentNote is now undefined so later typing hits scheduleSave with an undefined target and throws again.

app.js:10 Notes cannot be opened by keyboard: list rows are unfocusable li elements with a click handler on the ul. The li has no tabindex, no button or link, no role and no key handler (app.js:10, listener at app.js:30-33). The selected row is shown only by a background class, with no aria-current. With the keyboard only, Tab goes from search to New note to the title field. There is no stop on any note, so the user can never open a note other than the one auto-opened at load. The main task is blocked (WCAG 2.1.1, level A).

app.js:6 The list shows only filtered notes, but the displayed rank is computed over all notes, and the list is not re-rendered after a save. After the debounced save updates a title or updated, renderList is not called, so the list keeps the old title and old ranking until the next click or keystroke.
